timing_scope: Decoded BGR CPU image -> preprocessing/H2D -> one frozen R4 feature extraction/native head/NMS -> one B-local ROI sample -> B-conditioned LB -> CPU original-coordinate OBB. No M model. File read/decode separately reported; output validation outside timers.
historical_comparison: Same protocol and GPU model, separate batches. Keep sealed old timings; do not claim a newly measured same-batch module increment or paired speedup.
stop: Identity, numerical-equivalence, repeated/skipped stage, frozen-state, contention or resource failure stops without automatic retry or selection.
download: Core JSON/CSV/MD/SHA only; no weights, prediction rows, per-frame timings, resources or images.
